about: Chapter 7 into 8: Tim's 2024 statement (S1, page 2), the line about his father lit as the voice reaches it. The medical lines higher on the page stay soft.

marks.phrase: not going to live long enough to see his daughter free,

focus: not going to live long enough to see his daughter free,
soft: Since her incarceration she has developed physical ailments (uterine fibroids and possibly ovarian
cancer) according to the doctors who examined her in prison. She has received numerous blood
transfusions due to heavy bleeding and has been advised that she needs a hysterectomy, which
weight, her eyes are bulging. She has an abdominal bulge on her right side, and her complexion is
very pale. She told me that she still has to work in the prison despite her illness but that she can’t
lift heavy objects because her fibroids might rupture and she would start bleeding.
